profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Fulgent Genetics
profile.summary: I am a Solutions/Software engineer at Fulgent Genetics. I do a little bit of everything with strong interests of game development on the side!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer/AI Integation
positions.description:
-Designed and implemented a company-wide local inferencing system enabling curators to automate tedious workflows via human-in-the-loop strategies while preserving PHI-sensitive data, now serving over 20,000 local inference requests weekly.
-Architected the platform across multiple Linux machines, load-balancing several Ollama inference instances behind nginx and orchestrating them through a Node.js/Express service under pm2 for reliable, high-throughput serving.
-Identified and remediated security vulnerabilities across AI-integrated systems, implementing safeguards to protect sensitive data and infrastructure.
-Built an internal AI agent framework and orchestrator (Node.js backend, Vue frontend) letting teams deploy specialized, tool-calling agents with Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations in production.
positions.insights: GenAI Virtual Assistants, Model Context Protocol (MCP) and +4 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Developed daemons, unit tests, and web tools in Node.js powering the lab's end-to-end workflow systems.
-Partnered with LA County to build a system delivering free COVID tests to residents at scale.
-Scaled and maintained live laboratory software to reliably process over 1 million tests per month.
-Selected to lead the company's new AI-Ops team, delivering initiatives from concept to production.
-Integrated MongoDB into the stack to manage daemon process quorums and an internal chat system.
-Designed and implemented multiple relational database solutions in Oracle SQL to support core lab workflow systems.
-Built RESTful APIs and real-time SocketIO interfaces on Flask web servers.

positions.title: Game Developer
positions.description:
- Successfully ported the game "Paraiso Island" from PlayStation to Steam as well as implemented Steamworks API features such as achievements and network connectivity.
- Added extensive updates, features, downloadable content, and bug fixes via Unity in C#.
- Used Steam pipe (pipeline) to deploy builds along with extensive GitHub (Git Bash) and Teamwork usage.
- Ported to Xbox One using both XDK and Windows Universal Platform for Xbox One.
- Created tools for unit testing and debugging.
- Collaborated with top industry professionals regularly.

positions.title: Development Team Lead
positions.description:
- Was offered the team lead position in creating a 3D adventure game that combines abstract art and fast paced gameplay in Unity, C#.
- Responsible for gameplay engine, character controller,  animation, managing a team of 5 people, and collaboration with our sponsor.
- First team in Cal State LA’s Institute of Art, Research, and Technology to fully finish a game project on time.

See the video at:

projects.title: Nakamabound (Riftbound Simulator)
projects.description:
Riftbound Simulator is a full, rules-enforced simulator for the Riftbound trading card game. It runs in the browser, on phones, and as a desktop app.

- Card pool: over 1,300 cards from every released set, each tested by playing it in real games.
- Rules: the engine follows the official rulebook and errata, including combat, showdowns, the chain, costs and triggers.
- Ways to play: against a trained bot, against friends online in real-time multiplayer, or in Best-of-3 series with sideboarding.
- Tools: a deck builder, a card collection, replays of past games, and post-game stats.
- The bot: a tuned search bot, with a self-play neural-network line training alongside it.

https://www.spenceryoungcs.com/work/riftbound-simulator

projects.title: Race Against the Machine
projects.description: Race Against the Machine is an fast paced game directed by Prof. Sylke Rene Meyer (Television, Film, and Media Studies). The game mixes the reality of social power struggles of the 1960's, shown through the Chicano walkout movement, with a humorous and modular game play that changes with every play through. The enemy AI also uses decision tree machine learning AI to learn player behavior.
